bolumler.baslik: Things people pay for, or will
bolumler.giris: Each one is designed, written, shipped and kept running by me, on one server.
A puzzle heading for the App Store, and a couple of browser games.
Sites and internal systems for brands, each one drawn for its owner.
Smaller things, mostly built because I needed them.

en.kisa: The sales desk built around your team
en.metin: Instead of squeezing a team into an off-the-shelf CRM, it is set up around how they sell. Every customer from WhatsApp, Instagram, site chat and lead forms is tied to a rep and comes back to the same person. Calls, messages and outcomes sit on one screen.
Road freight, sea and air forwarding and warehousing in one system. The office plans loads, drivers update jobs from their phones, and customers follow a shipment through a link without signing in.

en.kisa: Bookkeeping for the business owner, not the accountant
en.metin: Customer and supplier accounts, stock, invoices, cash and bank, cheques and expenses, in plain words and on calm screens.

en.kisa: AI video tools for wedding filmmakers
en.metin: A rough cut assembled from hours of raw wedding footage, and cinematic clips made from still photos.

en.kisa: Footballers and basketball players in one draft
en.metin: Draft eleven-a-side or five-a-side from a mixed pool. Messi can play point guard and Jokić centre-back, at a cost. Solo, against the computer, or 1v1 with a friend.

en.kisa: A cozy sim about designing homes for a town
en.metin: Take a family's brief, design their house in a dollhouse cross-section, watch it go up and see them move in.

en.kisa: A football manager for a group of friends
en.metin: Everyone runs a club in the same league: transfers, tactics, match days and the arguments after.

en.kisa: A round-based tactical shooter, in Godot
en.metin: Five-on-five for friends. Every scene and script is plain text, so the whole game is written without opening the editor.

en.kisa: A portfolio for a photographer and filmmaker
en.metin: Dark and cinematic, work grouped by year, with a private upload door for new reels.

en.kisa: Four German business sites, moved off WordPress
en.metin: An events agency, an investment firm, a law office and an academy, rebuilt by hand on plain pages driven by JSON.

en.kisa: Plays a PC's sound on AirPods, through your iPhone
Keyboard lighting without the vendor's suite
Self-hosted voice chat for friends, with noise filtering
Video meetings that hold up on a weak connection
Clusters football news and posts the stories to X
Folk dances, lesson by lesson, checked by the camera
Thirty-day short-form series, drawn entirely in code
